note: First-order screens: linear elastic frame FE and closed forms. Not evidence that the fusion drive works; Gate 2 stays BLOCKED.

load_cases.title: Thrust
load_cases.path: burn -> field -> loops -> cage -> collar -> trunnions -> cradle -> struts -> thrust ring
load_cases.note: C-10 thrust per engine; SPECULATIVE (research exhaust velocity carried over). It acts on the loops as part of their field load.

load_cases.title: Coil forces (steady, coils energised)
load_cases.path: C1/C2 -> struts -> reaction ring -> tie rods -> collar; L1-L4 -> seats -> hoops -> longerons -> collar
load_cases.note: Exact loop-to-loop forces of the six coils (no third closure coil). Internal to one engine: they sum to zero, but every member between the coils carries them. They exceed the thrust by about 300 times.

load_cases.title: Inter-engine field force (steady)
load_cases.path: coils -> engine -> trunnions -> cradle -> spokes / chords -> hub
load_cases.note: Exact coil-set forces: each engine is pulled toward the axis (neighbours of opposite polarity attract side by side). The 1.1 cluster note called it repulsion and a pulse transient; it is attraction and steady while the coils are energised. Point-dipole pair estimate 15.8 MN adjacent. Net external force zero by symmetry; internal frame loads remain.

load_cases.title: Pulse loads at 5.7 kHz
load_cases.path: field compression on the windings each pulse; mount transmits the ripple
load_cases.note: Each pulse delivers thrust/f of impulse. Cycle count per firing hour exceeds measured S-N data for every catalogue structural alloy; the pulse field change on the windings (EXTREME case) is a fatigue load with an OPEN pulse shape.

load_cases.title: Thermal
load_cases.path: armour -> lithium headers -> manifold -> service panel -> cluster heat exchanger
load_cases.note: The design areal heat load is 29 times the research armour value (VTX-S3). Cold-mass contraction, hot headers and the LiH shield each need sliding or flexible joints.

load_cases.title: Operations: single engine, coil loss, maintenance
load_cases.note: One engine firing gives a thrust moment about the ship axis; one engine's coils off unbalances the field forces on its neighbours.

thermal.header_alpha_basis: ESTIMATE 5-9e-6 /K (refractory alloys near 1800 K; not in the catalogue: every candidate's expansion is OPEN there)

dynamics.winding_note: 316LN cryogenic modulus is OPEN in the catalogue, so the winding breathing modes are not computed; the windings take the pulse field change directly, so mount isolation does not protect them

notes.longeron: Compression and Euler buckling between hoops under the loop forces; NOMINAL coils.
notes.hoop: Ring bending under the eight seats' radial share (closed form P R/2 (1/a - cot a)).
notes.seat: Inclined strut carrying its loop's axial share. The cold-mass support behind it carries the same force; its heat leak is OPEN.
notes.strut: Compression and buckling: the closure coil is pushed forward by the loops.
notes.ring: Frame FE (ring + tie rods, converged on 3.75 deg): twelve strut seats, eight tie rods.
notes.tie_rod: Frame FE: the kink round the shield rim puts the rods in bending as well as compression.
notes.winding: Hoop tension in the steel case share (316LN, 2/3 of the 4.2 K proof stress); sized for NOMINAL only.
notes.collar: Balance point: 94 MN in from the closure struts, the same out through the cage. Flange and lug design OPEN.
notes.trunnion: Pin shear: worst engine reaction 56 MN over four pins, utilisation 0.27.
notes.shield: Carries no coil load by design (tie rods go round it). LiH grows 18 mm more than titanium per 100 K at the rim: sliding seats.
notes.heat: Design heat flux 29x the research armour load (VTX-S3): no material in the catalogue covers it.
notes.cryostat: Vacuum vessel; the cold-mass supports inside carry the coil forces (OPEN).
notes.joint: Segment split flange; the winding inside is continuous, so the joint carries no hoop load. Local design OPEN.
notes.burn: No hardware: the burn is in the open field.
notes.launcher: 46.7 km/s at 5697 Hz (VTX-S2); recoil 266 kN per gram of target (target mass OPEN).
notes.shutter: As a 24-slot tungsten chopper the rim runs 567 m/s: rho v^2 = 6.2 GPa, tungsten strength OPEN. A CFRP rotor would see 530 MPa (allowable 858), radiation tolerance OPEN.
notes.alignment: Pointing 102 microrad holds a 1 mm miss over 9.8 m; actuator loads OPEN (target mass).
notes.pulsed: Pulsed power at the design rate: SPECULATIVE.
notes.leads: 68 kA leads; 9.7 GJ stored per engine; go/return pair force 9.2 kN/m (clamped pair).
notes.lithium: At 1800 K no catalogue alloy has a service rating (Nb-1Zr stops near 1400 K); one supply line carries 0.0022 % of the fusion power (VTX-S3).
notes.cryo: Cryogen flow and the cold heat budget are OPEN.
notes.nonstructural: Not on a primary load path; not sized.

case_allowable.note: 0.2 % proof stress of ITER-grade plate at 4.2 K; held to 20 K as a screening value (austenitic proof stress rises on cooling, so the 4 K value bounds the 20 K one only approximately)
